name: claude-code
title: Claude Code headless launcher
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Launch Claude Code stream/control agents in the vqro agent UI; native TUI remains separate.
description: Route 1 uses the backend-owned vqro-bridge-claude and native user login/settings without bare mode or a startup prompt. Literal send is currently qualified by source for CLI2.1.329; other versions remain observable without guessed input guarantees. Native TUI parity, profile management and authentication are not provided. Disabling this extension leaves existing processes intact.

needs.why: The headless bridge and native CLI execute in one backend-owned terminal

works_with.without: Human Control remains available; route initialization is unconfirmed and never replays the launch
Request routing remains unconfirmed, never a native launch retry
The created agent opens as its bridge terminal
The observed host remains reachable through the resource picker
